hanzo: Natural Agility (trait): jump over walls or structures to escape a dive, chase a kill, or take a surprise angle; it's your only escape, so don't waste it.
hogger: Loot Hoard (trait): toss it to knock a diving enemy away or block a chokepoint; the junk pile is terrain, so drop it between you and a chaser.
imperius: Valorous Brand (trait): after a Basic Ability, weave in Basic Attacks to consume the marks for bonus damage and a big self-heal, best when you're low.
johanna: Iron Skin (trait): activate as you get focused or CC'd; the shield makes you Unstoppable, so use it to break a stun or eat burst, not preemptively.
kaelthas: Verdant Spheres (trait): spend your sphere on the ability you want empowered this cast; save one for a guaranteed Living Bomb or Flamestrike when it matters.
leoric: Undying (trait): as a ghost after death, drift toward the fight so you resurrect in position, not off in base; use the downtime to stay relevant.
liming: Critical Mass (trait): don't hold your combo; a takedown refunds every cooldown, so commit fully to a dive and chain onto the next target.
lostvikings: Spread all three Vikings on separate lanes to soak XP, then pull them together with Longboat or before a fight; never leave them scattered when 5v5 starts.
lucio: Push Off (trait): while riding terrain, activate it to slide into an enemy for the 75% slow to peel or set up a kill, or to dash yourself out of danger.
maiev: Vault of the Wardens (trait): leap as a key stun or skillshot lands; the 0.75s immunity dodges it entirely, so react to the enemy cast, not on cooldown.
malfurion: Innervate (trait): cast it on a spell-hungry ally during a fight; the 50% faster cooldowns let them keep chaining abilities, not to refill mana between fights.
mei: Cryo-Freeze (trait): freeze to break CC and survive burst, but you can't act while frozen, so time it to bait key cooldowns and thaw into the follow-up.
murky: Spawn Egg (trait): tuck your Egg in a bush near the fight so you respawn in 8s; move it forward as you push and never leave it exposed to enemies.
nova: Permanent Cloak (trait): stand still 1.5s to upgrade your stealth to Invisible before crossing enemy vision, so you approach a target unrevealed.
orphea: Overflowing Chaos (trait): land a Basic Ability then immediately weave a Basic Attack to spend Chaos for bonus damage; don't let stacks sit or expire unused.
